column1: # Defects of tools/audit_hunts.py that were looked at and left: the owner accepted them or they need a map edit (server/README.md "Hunt audit (O337)").
# tools/audit_hunts.py --check fails on a defect that is not listed here and on a listed one that is gone

column3: Tier II cave: 78 spawns on 1882 tiles, a 35 s sweep (limit 45). The whole rectangle of the map holds 2020 walkable tiles (136 of them cut off), so there is no ground to count; a bigger cave would be new map ground inside a waystone rectangle that the boss script and the cleanup read. O337 call: left, the smallest of the 12 maps by design.

Tier VI forest and desert: 20,896 walkable tiles, a 392 s sweep (limit 300). O337: the fill brought it to 3.15 monsters per 100 (659 monsters, was 1.9). It is open land: the dead ends behind necks of up to 10 tiles hold 1,108 of the 5,110 tiles that would have to go, the lobes worth 4,700 tiles sit behind necks of 40 to 90 tiles (300 tiles of fence). Left whole; the run to the boss is route-limited, not sweep-limited.
By design: the late game monsters (level 940) replace weaker spawns in an area of level 344 monsters (tools/late_game.py).

Four floors of stone halls: 146 monsters, a 43 s sweep (limit 45); the box holds 3161 walkable tiles and 2630 are in reach of a monster. O337 call: a bigger late game area needs new ground; left, 2 s under the limit.
By design: late game monsters (level 810) among level 338 ones.

O337: thinned from 149 to 78 monsters (5.4 per 100, was 10.2; spawn_expand.json `remove` rows, never a late_game_spawns.csv row), the region stays 1454 tiles. A 25 s sweep (limit 45): one compact hall of three floors whose box holds no more walkable ground; a bigger area needs map editing.
58 monsters on 1027 tiles, an 18 s sweep; the box (two floors) holds 1107 walkable tiles in all. O337 call: a bigger late game area needs new ground and level 700+ monsters to fill it; left.
